propositions: A parent removed in Jira never clears the local parent_id because the fetcher omits absent parents from the snapshot and the differ refuses to emit parent_id=None
The differ cannot distinguish 'Jira has no parent' from 'parent key not yet bound' without positive peer evidence, causing spurious clears on degraded reads
The inbound parent-clear feature was destructively released without peer-state evidence gates, clearing 63 local parents that rebar never pushed to the peer
The fix requires arbitrating on per-binding peer-parent observation persisted in binding_store, advanced only when a pass observes the parent field, and used to gate clears
Existing consumers of snapshot parent field use .get() and branch on falsiness, so explicit None is backward-compatible if the field key is present
A same-pass outbound write suppression exists via _OUTBOUND_TO_INBOUND_FIELD entry but cannot fire when the outbound parent path is never emitted due to hierarchy gates
